children: EcoGraf Limited reported a value engineering review indicating a potential 20% increase in Epanko Stage 1 nameplate capacity to 87,600 tpa, with C1 costs down ~5.8% to ~$512/t for the first 10 years. The case needs ~$12.0M extra capex and will be finalised post-FID.

Higher volumes can lift revenue and margins if markets absorb supply.

Incremental capex ~$12.0M
Modest capex vs throughput gain; payback could be attractive if prices hold.
AISC ~$611/t (10yrs), down ~4.4%
All-in costs trend lower, supporting project economics.
Base case 73Ktpa remains for financing
Upside not yet in debt case; reduces near-term certainty of uplift.
Life of mine 20 yrs vs 22 yrs
Faster depletion; earlier cash but shorter mine life if no expansion.
